jd.title: Clinical Research Coordinator
jd.text: Coordinate clinical trials: patient screening and enrolment, informed consent, CRF completion, GCP compliance, data entry in EDC systems and liaison with investigators. A nursing background is preferred; GCP certification is a plus.
